description: Election Commission - H. Tilakarathna was elected as the member of the Eheliyagoda P/S - S. M. A. Kumarihami was selected as the member of the Badulla M/C
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha and Badulla Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, including the declaration of elected members to fill seats vacated due to death and party membership cessation. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters and candidate declarations for local government positions.
